scenario.tests: A smooth 90-degree right-hand arc (16 points, no turn instruction) followed by one real left turn. Distance-to-turn must be measured along the route, not straight-line.
expect: no turn instruction anywhere on the arc (the arc vertices are not steps)
'In 40 meters, turn left onto Hill Street' at along ~113 m (40 m before the turn at ~153 m, partly on the arc)
'Turn left now onto Hill Street' at along ~143 m
arrival at along ~191 m; no off_route or wrong-way on the arc
